findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.comment: Observed two dented cans of broth and chicken dumpling soup on an aisle shelf. The dents were observed on the seams of the cans. Discussed with PIC and cans were pulled from the shelf. Ensure that the packaging of all foods are in good condition to protect the integrity of the contents.
findings.citation_text: 3-202.15 Package Integrity. FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: There was an open air cooler that appears to no longer be functional near the main entrance. If there aren’t any future plans for usage of the cooler, be sure to discard the cooler, as it is no longer necessary to the daily operations of the facility.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.114 Maintaining Premises, Unnecessary Items and Litter. The PREMISES shall be free of: (A) Items that are unnecessary to the operation or maintenance of the establishment such as EQUIPMENT that is nonfunctional or no longer used; and (B) Litter.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.citation_text:
6-202.15 (A) Outer openings were observed with varying amounts of wear to weather stripping resulting in gaps. The most significant gaps were observed at the outer door in the storage area where gaps were present at the very top and the lower half of the doors.
Ensure doors are maintained as tight fitting as possible and that weather stripping is replaced as needed to help minimize potential entry points for pests, including along the bottom of the double automatic doors at the entrance.
Outer openings of a food establishment shall be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by: (1) Filling or closing holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings; (2) Closed, tight-fitting windows; and (3) Solid, self-closing, tight-fitting doors.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.citation_text:
5-205.15 Water was observed spraying from the vacuum breaker at the mop sink when the faucet was in use. Provide proper repairs.
A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text:
6-501.11 1) Ceiling tiles were missing at the hallway between the restrooms and at the corner above the door in the restroom. Employee noted ceiling tiles in restrooms were moved out of the way but still present up in the ceiling but was unsure as to the availability of tiles for the hallway. Provide ceiling tiles in the hallway, and leave ceiling tiles in place as much as possible in the restroom (see general comments for additional information) 

2) Ceiling exhaust fan cover was missing in the restroom. Provide proper cover for the exhaust fan.
Physical facilities shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: Observed the inside of the milk and orange juice cooler in the storage area of the store to be soiled with milk and other residue. Ensure this is cleaned and maintained clean. 
NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.citation_text: 750.1170 Gap at bottom of back loading door and gap in between these double doors. Reseal doors to protect from rodent entry.

findings.title: Rooms and equipment - vented as required
findings.citation_text: 750.1250 Ventilation fans in the men's restroom do not appear to be operating. One ventilation fan in the women's restroom is missing and the other does not seem to be operating. Replace and repair ventilation fans in restrooms.

findings.title: Wholesome, sound condition
findings.comment:
CORRECTED > Observed two cans of soup and one can of sweet potatoes on the display shelves to have denting along the top, bottom, or side seam. Cans were physically separated from stock for credit.
750-100 Food shall be in sound condition, free from spoilage, filth, and other contamination and shall be safe for human consumption.

findings.comment:
No covered waste can was observed in the women's restroom. Provide a covered waste can in the women's restroom.
750-1110d Toilet facilities shall be kept clean and in good repair and free of objectionable odors. A supply of toilet tissue shall be provided at each toilet at all times. Easily cleanable, covered receptacles shall be provided for waste materials.
